statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-21712 is a Node.js crash: url.format() called with a malformed internationalized domain name hits an assertion failure in native URL code and terminates the process. The advisory lists 24.x and 25.x as affected. Node.js fixed it for 24.x in 24.14.1, the 2026-03-24 security release (https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/march-2026-security-releases), with commit cba66c48a5, 'src: handle url crash on different url formats' (https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/cba66c48a5), which carries this CVE id. Release notes: https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.14.1. We read the node binary in the DHI nodejs-24 packages for Alpine 3.23 on x86_64 and aarch64 from the first published build through the boundary: 24.13.0-r0, 24.13.1-r0 and 24.14.0-r0 report Node.js 24.13.0, 24.13.1 and 24.14.0, and 24.14.1-r0 is the first that reports Node.js v24.14.1. The later packages in the DHI Alpine repository are versioned 24.15.0-r0 to 24.22.3-r0.
